item.title: Communication: Senior Impact Accelerator
item.description: Impact Acceleration The European Policy Centre (EPC) is a leading independent think tank in the heart of Brussels, providing balanced, impactful research that advances our mission of greater European integration. In a volatile, fast-moving world where permanent change and recurring crises are a reality, the EPC is looking for a communications professional to help us sharpen and accelerate our impact as the think tank enters its fourth decade. The successful candidate will have sharp political instincts combined with a proven capacity to respond to rapidly changing European and global events. He/She/They will have experience of the latest communications technology, be keen to experiment and innovate, have a solid pool of relevant media contacts in Brussels and national capitals – or a strong interest in developing them - and be able to craft key messages to the relevant actors to maximise our impact in a timely and effective manner. We are looking to cover the following tasks and workflows: Accelerating Impact Ensure Smooth Communications Manage the EPC team of communications professionals working in events, publications, social media, media outreach functions and assistants. Project Management based approach: Working at the EPC in this role requires relevant experience, innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, flexibility, patience, leadership and empathy. People specifications: Additional Assets: To apply: Please specify your name + SENIOR IMPACT ACCELERATOR in the file names submitted by the form below. Deadline for applicants: 17.00 on October 30th Your application should contain: A one paragraph information statement about which of the above tasks and workflows you are strongest in and where you need to grow. A one paragraph information statement about team leadership experience and approach. The EPC is a registered AiSBL with a limited budget. We cannot offer high fees, but an opportunity to join a team of passionate, values driven people committed to democracy, rule of law and European integration. Due to the high number of applications we normally receive, we can only contact shortlisted candidates. The EPC is an equal opportunities organisation. We value diversity and particularly encourage applicants from sectors of society that are not well represented in Brussels think tanks, Brussels-based civil society or European policy making.
